baseline.note: captured before the first store-wire edit; never regenerated

address_rules.identity: two records share an address iff their 2-byte feature sets are equal
address_rules.anchor: a query anchors on every address that owns one of its document-frequency-1 features

exits.no_match: an unseen feature OR no unique feature in the query

address_rules.write: grow-before-append; equal value merges; different value replaces and keeps the displaced snapshot in history; one batch with equal feature sets and different values is rejected whole

global_check.G-A: every stored record reads back to itself or abstains, never to another address
global_check.G-B: a write cannot remove the anchor of an address it did not touch
global_check.G-C: no two addresses share a feature set

address_rules.value: the write stores the current fast snapshot; a matched read blends it with alpha=0.5; an abstention returns the same state object
